items.text: Brock Bowers ruled OUT for Sunday Week 1 after meniscus trim; expected to miss 1-2 games. Michael Mayer elevated as primary TE beneficiary with recent extension.
items.why: Meniscus procedure late in camp; official Friday injury report and Schefter confirmation.
items.implication: TE1 void in LV; immediate waiver/start bump for Mayer and any residual targets to WRs/RBs.
items.opportunity: Full TE snaps/routes/red-zone for Mayer; Raiders pace may still support volume.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty officially IN and off injury report, good to go vs Dolphins after ankle sprain recovery; full participant.
items.why: Full practices mid-week; Schefter/Rapoport and Raiders report clearance.
items.implication: RB1 locked in; ADP recovery confirmed, though possible early workload management after missed camp.
items.opportunity: Primary carries/routes; monitor any committee with backups if limited.

items.text: Malik Nabers QUESTIONABLE (knee); full practices but coach non-committal; Giants elevated depth WRs as precaution. God will decide per player comments.
items.why: Official listing despite full week; elevations of Berrios/Cambre.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT, major WR target vacuum for Fields/Mooney types and Likely TE bump.
items.opportunity: If active, still monitor snap/route limits post-ACL; if out, beneficiaries get full opportunity.

items.text: Patriots officially place A.J. Brown on IR with high ankle sprain; out minimum 4 games. Roster spot filled by DT signing.
items.why: Confirmed by sources and team move Saturday.
items.implication: NE WR1 void for weeks; boost remaining receivers and check TE/RB targets.
items.opportunity: Immediate target share increase for other NE pass-catchers.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey BUY LOW contrarian: preseason bangs, long flight, weird game explain limited usage and Kaelon Black looks; not worried long-term.
items.why: Context of preseason and travel; historical resilience.
items.implication: Hold/buy in trades; expect rebound snaps/carries.
items.opportunity: Primary back role intact once fully right.
items.conflict: Conflicts with raw early usage optics favoring Black.

items.text: Sean Tucker (hamstring) DOUBTFUL/absence gives sneaky goal-line boost to Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell in TB backfield.
items.why: Tucker doubtful on ETR report; Levitan flags GL opportunity shift.
items.implication: Elevated TD upside for Irving/Gainwell in committee.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/red-zone carries increase with Tucker sidelined.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) QUESTIONABLE status is impactful for Travis Etienne projection; Etienne primary if Kamara limited/out after Saints signing.
items.why: Kamara return from minor knee but age/role shift; Levitan links directly to Etienne volume.
items.implication: Etienne RB upside rises with any Kamara restriction; monitor final status.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes/third-down for Etienne if Kamara out or limited.

items.text: Most ADP-tanked August injury guys cleared for Week 1: Jeanty, Jeremiyah Love, Emeka Egbuka, Alec Pierce, etc. Some docks remain for missed camp time.
items.why: Final report clearances reverse summer ADP drops; Levitan notes residual conditioning docks.
items.implication: Start with confidence but temper pure volume expectations early.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase listed IN and expected to play after knee scare in camp; full clearance trending.
items.why: Practiced and cleared on final report.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected with Higgins also trending up.

items.text: Tua/Penix OUT, Cooper Rush starts (back spasms but will go): lower expectations for Bijan/London/Pitts but still start all; Rush competent/serviceable not amazing.
items.why: QB downgrade to Rush confirmed by team/Schefter; still functional offense.
items.implication: Slight projection trim but no sit; volume remains.
items.opportunity: Bijan carries secure; pass-catchers still viable.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard flex-viable this week; keeping it open (The Chubbler) amid Brooks status.
items.why: Brooks limited/groin history; Hubbard standalone flex floor.
items.opportunity: Carries if Brooks limited (ETR has Brooks IN).
items.conflict: ETR lists Brooks IN; potential committee.

items.text: Raiders agree 3-year $45M extension with TE Michael Mayer ($30M guaranteed, ~$15M APY 4th among TEs); first rookie-deal ext since Renfrow.
items.implication: Long-term role security; short-term TE1 with Bowers out.
items.opportunity: Confirmed starter snaps while Bowers sidelined.

items.text: Malik Davis OUT (hip, Friday practice injury); late-round handcuff loss for DAL. Levitan notes tough runout.
items.why: Hip injury in Friday practice; official OUT.
items.implication: DAL RB depth thins; monitor other backups behind Williams.

items.text: Saquon Barkley makes Week 1 Love List despite Commanders fandom pain; strong historical matchup vs WAS.
items.why: Avg 136+ rush yds and 21+ PPR in prior vs WAS; front seven still below avg.
